facts.fact: Decree 2018-471 of 10 October 2018 (art. 10) refers to the birth acts recorded in the paper registers currently available in the civil-status centres, which are to be scanned under ANIP; it describes no digital entry at those centres, and does not say in terms that they register on paper only.

systems.system: enregistrement à titre dérogatoire à l'état civil
systems.platform: an information management system is authorised; enrolment and testimony forms read by QR code; an application encodes the personal identification number on the draft acts
systems.owner: Comité technique de pilotage chaired by the Director General of ANIP, under a Comité national de suivi chaired by the Minister of the Interior; costs charged to the State budget
systems.tiers: Lists drawn up by arrondissement and commune for people enrolled in the identification census with no birth certificate; the prosecutor requisitions each mayor to enter them in the current year's birth register; draft acts go to the competent civil-status officers for signature

systems.platform: scanning, with full or partial character recognition
systems.tiers: Birth acts in the paper registers held in the civil-status centres
Built from the acts of the derogatory registration and the scanned paper registers; interoperable with the biometric population register for its updating

systems.system: registre national biométrique de la population
systems.country_label: registre national biométrique de la population
systems.tiers: National; signed birth acts are attached to the persons concerned in it

systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification des Personnes (ANIP), whose head is civil-status officer with national territorial competence
systems.tiers: Issued on request, whatever the place of birth, at ANIP or its departmental or communal representations, carrying the encoded personal identification number

systems.system: système de communication électronique des données de l'état civil
systems.tiers: To be set up for identification and control of personal data, under a later decree

note: The decree's digital registration is the one-off derogatory registration of people enrolled without a birth certificate, and its dematerialisation is the scanning of existing registers: neither is routine digital entry at the office where a birth is declared.
